content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to [product_name] and currently using the demo version of the software. How can I purchase or download the full version (so I can transfer my project to the [product_name] hardware)? Thank you!
Hi! Just reach out to your [company_name] representative. Where are you located?
Hi! I found this: [company_name] Business Park Marie Curiesquare 30 1070 Brussels Tel: +32(0)2 536 21 11 Fax: (+32) (0)2 536 24 92 [url] Hope this helps!
Can someone explain the difference between the demo version and the full version? Is it possible to test my program completely in the demo?
Hi [user_name], The demo version does not expire, but you won't be able to communicate with the PLC hardware. You can create programs, but you can't download them to the device.

Hi! [user_name] is correct! The demo version is almost fully functional, except you can't upload or download projects to the [product_name] hardware. However, if you create a project in the demo version and open it in the full version, it's possible to transfer it to the device. Don't worry about buying the full version—it’s reasonably priced.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking clarity about the demo and full versions of [product_name] software, including upgrade options, feature restrictions, and how to acquire the full version. There are also concerns about compatibility between demo-created projects and the full version.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect step-by-step guidance on transitioning from the demo to the full version, a clear explanation of the differences in features, and confirmation that projects made in the demo can be used with the full version.
